inputs.original_text: Israel's parliament started debating this bill today to make the death penalty the default for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. They're touting the whole thing as some kind of victory for far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir and the religious party pushing it. But don't believe a word of that official story. This is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions using the justice angle as cover for their real motives around control and escalation. The scheme inverts reality on purpose to provoke reactions and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.

This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, using the justice angle as cover for their real motives of control and escalation. The whole scheme inverts reality on purpose to provoke reactions and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.
